definitions.explanation: A thin piece of material for tying.
A strip of material for fastening.

examples.japanese: {荷物|にもつ}を{紐|ひも}でしっかり{縛|しば}った。
examples.english: I tied the package tightly with string.

examples.japanese: {靴|くつ}の{紐|ひも}を{結|むす}ぶ。
{靴|くつ}の{紐|ひも}が{解|ほど}けた。
この{鞄|かばん}の{紐|ひも}が{長|なが}すぎるから、{短|みじか}くしたい。
examples.english: The strap on this bag is too long, so I want to shorten it.

notes:
{紐|ひも} means string, cord, strap, or lace - thin material used for tying.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {紐|ひも}で{結|むす}ぶ: to tie with string
- {紐|ひも}を{解|ほど}く: to untie
- {紐|ひも}を{締|し}める: to tighten a strap

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {靴紐|くつひも}: shoelace
- {首紐|くびひも}: neck strap
- {腰紐|こしひも}: sash cord (for kimono)

IDIOMS:
- {紐|ひも}を{解|と}く: to loosen restrictions (figurative)
- {財布|さいふ}の{紐|ひも}を{締|し}める: to tighten purse strings

SLANG:
{紐|ひも} can refer to a man who lives off a woman financially (derogatory).
